appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'. This printed title contradicts the visual direction of the line.
A single blue line series spans the full x-axis from 1880 to 1891. The line starts low on the left and ends high on the right, indicating an overall upward trend.
The line is flat at approximately 1,100 for the first two years.
The line rises steadily from ~1,300 to a local peak of ~2,450 in 1887.
The line dips slightly in 1888 to ~2,250, then climbs sharply to its highest point of ~3,200 in 1891.
Despite the title saying 'Decreasing', the visual data shows a net increase from ~1,100 in 1880 to ~3,200 in 1891.

printed_facts.fact: Label is 'Number of Tourists'. Scale runs from 0 to 3,500 with major ticks at intervals of 500.
Label is 'Year'. Ticks are labeled for every year from 1880 to 1891.
Printed text: 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.

uncertain: The chart title explicitly states 'Decreasing', but the plotted line clearly shows an increasing trend. It is unclear if the title is a typo or if the data represents something else (e.g., a different metric), but based strictly on the visual line graph, the number of tourists is increasing.
